== Player photographs (2026-10-16) ==
Dested identified player photographs from Players Committee wrap-up articles on starwarsccg.org. Captions name the people; group shots sit on the event page and crops sit on person pages that had no photograph. Wayback of some starwarsccg.org wrap-ups was offline; those File pages cite the swccg.com hosted snapshot until a Wayback capture of that snapshot can be opened.
